reason: dsh-polyglot is an LLM provider router for DSH that adapts to OpenAI-compatible endpoints, supports configurable provider presets and automatic fallback, and reports usage by provider.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 提供兼容 OpenAI API 的大语言模型适配、提供商链路切换、限流故障转移和用量统计。
summaries.en: Routes DSH language-model requests through configurable OpenAI-compatible providers with presets, rate-limit fallback, and usage tracking.

capabilities: Sends chat-completion requests to configured OpenAI-compatible provider endpoints
Uses configured API keys or credential references for provider access
Automatically retries eligible failures on alternate configured providers
Records provider, token, success, failure, and estimated cost information in session logs
